verdict.rationale: Simular's own developer docs cover the pieces of a bring-up path: a Python SDK installed with `pip install sai-sdk`, an API that sends a plain-language task (POST /v1/agents/message) and streams progress (GET /v1/agents/events), and an MCP server for coding agents. Sai then completes the task on a cloud Windows computer. However, no evidence shows a dedicated quickstart that walks from install to a first completed task, and no hands-on report confirms the docs alone are enough. Missing for 10: an evidenced end-to-end quickstart guide (auth/API key setup, first-task walkthrough), any independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-task, and a published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404).
